scope: Linux wheel file-ownership and CPython import-selection inspection; no co-install/uninstall or native-code execution.

review_candidate_wheel.build_identity: Preserved release wheel from the f64-weight candidate before the single-centroid mean-preservation fix. Not the final release head.

later_reviewed_wheel.head: 22867bd55739a96a6fab3c8c48b27406ecb32197
later_reviewed_wheel.hash_provenance: Provided by root from the preserved release gate; not rehashed during benchmark timing.
later_reviewed_wheel.inspection: Static ZIP central-directory and METADATA read confirms the same namespace overlap, shim/native filenames and runtime dependency metadata.

import_resolution.runtime: CPython on WSL Linux; exact interpreter patch version was not recorded for this probe.
import_resolution.method: Create an empty tdigest_rs.abi3.so and tdigest_rs.py in one temporary package directory, matching the observed wheel basenames. Call importlib.machinery.PathFinder.find_spec('tdigest_rs.tdigest_rs', [directory]); inspect the returned spec without executing it.
import_resolution.meaning: When the two wheel contents coexist on one package path, the original extension shadows the replacement shim. This is an import-precedence check, not a complete pip deployment test.

recommendation: Publish the upstream replacement as the same tdigest-rs distribution, so a normal upgrade removes the previous distribution's native file. Do not install the private gr-tdigest compatibility wheel beside tdigest-rs. Keep one distribution owner per Python namespace and verify real upgrade/uninstall transitions before release.
